Inferential Models (IMs) are originated from the book, as seen here, by [Ryan Martin](https://martinrg07.github.io) and Chuanhai Liu from 2015. It provides a tool outside the Frequentist and Bayesian frameworks that offers the capability of uncertainty quantification and reliability guarantee. Up till now, the introduction of IMs almost solely relies on publications, which require concision and generality. To help interested readers use IMs, this website provide practical guides and general information not delivered by publications, such as tutorials, toy examples, recent updates, etc.
